git.frontend_env_note: frontend/.env is modified in the working tree from prior Build 1B state (11 added lines); it was NOT touched or staged by this correction

observed_defects.label_mass: The active storey (~200 BIM spaces) rendered a permanent text label for EVERY room with a label anchor, producing an unreadable label mass (screenshot provenance: 200 rooms / 2 exact / 198 approx dashed / walker live).
observed_defects.mini_plan_toolbar: The mini-plan carried a Fit / + / - / arrow (up/down/left/right) control row plus zoom/pan/autoFit state; the plan should auto-fit only.
observed_defects.mini_plan_close: The mini-plan offered only a collapse toggle that hid the body but kept the panel; there was no proper close, and no compact reopen.
observed_defects.walkthrough_card_obstruction: The ENTIRE Walkthrough control card rendered unconditionally on mode==='WALKTHROUGH'; only the small key-controls help subsection was dismissible, so the card obstructed the 3D scene with no way to clear it.

root_cause.label_mass: Bim2dPlanPanel rendered a <text> for every room that had a labelAnchor; there was no label-density policy.
root_cause.walkthrough_card: In CameraModeControl the whole mode==='WALKTHROUGH' JSX branch was unconditional; controlsHelpOpen governed ONLY the .camera-mode-help subsection, never the card.

added: isProgramClinicalFunction(fn) — UNASSIGNED_EXISTING and undefined are NOT program assignments
resolvePlanRoomLabel(room, hoveredId?) — CLINICAL always permanent, SELECTED always permanent, HOVERED transient, else NONE
pure_layer.purity: No @itwin, no DOM, no viewport; deterministic.

removed: .bim2d-plan-toolbar Fit / + / - / up / down / left / right buttons
zoom / panPx / autoFit state and fit/zoomBy/panBy handlers
changed: Labels now decided by resolvePlanRoomLabel (Clinical Program permanent + badge; selected permanent; hovered transient; rest unlabelled with identity on hover/click)
Transform always auto-fits the active storey bounds into the compact canvas
VIEW_W/VIEW_H shrunk from 360x300 to 260x200; CSS width clamp(200px,22vw,280px)
Collapse toggle replaced by a proper x close -> compact '2D Plan' reopen chip; while closed only the chip renders (no panel body / no SVG / no blocking layer)
Added hover identity (transient, no store write) via onMouseMove/onMouseLeave
preserved: Room click selects the SAME bimSpaceId (setClinicalProgramSelectedSpace + fitViewToClinicalRoom) and NEVER moves the walker
Enter Walkthrough Here uses enterWalkthroughAtClinicalRoom (safe spawn; no teleport-on-click)
Walker marker from the single walkthrough read-model via subscribeWalkthroughState
Exact vs approximate (dashed) provenance and honest counts

added: walkthroughCardOpen state collapsing the WHOLE walkthrough control block (storeys/FOV/turn/reset/exit/key-controls) to a compact 'Walkthrough Controls' reopen chip
Esc-first collapse in the CAPTURE phase with stopPropagation (one Esc = one action); once collapsed, Esc falls through to the controller's pointer-release
Outside-click collapse via window pointerdown + target.closest('.camera-mode') test (NO full-screen invisible blocker)
Fresh full card on each walkthrough entry (setWalkthroughCardOpen(true))
preserved: EXIT WALKTHROUGH remains reachable in the collapsed state
Controller pointer-release semantics untouched when the card is already collapsed
The inner key-controls help pane keeps its own x/reopen (renamed to 'Walkthrough key controls')

changed: Removed .bim2d-plan.collapsed / .bim2d-plan-collapse / .bim2d-plan-toolbar rules; shrank .bim2d-plan width and .bim2d-plan-svg height

updated_files: frontend/src/tests/build1bPlan2dUi.test.tsx (retargeted to 260x200; replaced toolbar/collapse tests with §PB5 UX-correction assertions)
frontend/src/tests/build1aWalkthroughControlsPaneUi.test.tsx (retargeted inner help pane aria-labels to 'Walkthrough key controls'; card-level Esc/outside-click moved to the new §25 suite)

coverage.22_label_density: A 200-room floor yields only 2 permanent labels (clinical), 3 when one ordinary room is selected; hover is transient and excluded from countPermanentPlanLabels; UNASSIGNED_EXISTING is not a program label; badges verified.
coverage.23_floor_plan_geometry: All 200 rooms project a polygon regardless of labelling; the label policy never alters ring/footprintSource/labelAnchor; exact vs approximate preserved.
coverage.24_walker_immutability: Resolving labels for every room does not mutate the walker read-model and label density is independent of walker presence.
coverage.25_mini_plan_ui: No Fit/+/-/arrow toolbar; only the Clinical Program room is permanently labelled ([U] Uptake 01); selecting adds exactly one SELECTED label; x closes to a compact '2D Plan' chip with no panel body/SVG and reopen restores the walker; click selects same bimSpaceId and never moves the walker.
coverage.25_walkthrough_card_ui: x collapses the whole card (EXIT still reachable, not an exit); first Esc collapses (not exit to PLANNING); outside-click collapses (inside keeps open); reopen restores; EXIT works from collapsed state.
